description: Deterministic hand-computable golden test cases for Phase 6E Deterministic 7-Day Meal Planning, Variety & Repetition Control.

cases.description: Exact 7-day valid week where each day satisfies daily nutrition targets without target deviations. sum_J_day = 0.0, days_full_targets_met = 7.
Comparing a sequence repeating the single best day vs selecting slightly varied alternative days. Under soft variety policy, varied sequence can be selected when nutrition is comparable.
Alternating between PK_DISH_001 (Chapati) and PK_PORTION_001 (Standard Chapati) must map to the same EQ_CHAPATI concept and correctly trigger concept occurrence penalties.

Week A has sum_J_day = 0.0 with soft repetition penalty > 0. Week B has sum_J_day = 0.80 with soft repetition penalty = 0. Week A must be selected because daily nutrition strictly takes priority over soft variety.
When possible weekly candidate combinations exceed maximum_week_candidate_sequences_evaluated, search is deterministically truncated and surfaces BETTER_UNEVALUATED_WEEK_MAY_EXIST.

Candidate week violating a caller-specified HARD constraint is rejected completely and never returned as best_week or in alternative_weeks. If all sequences violate hard constraints, returns NO_VALID_WEEK_PLAN.
Identical candidate day pool and variety policy under GENERAL, PCOS, and MALE_HYPOGONADISM. Must produce 100% identical sequence selection, repetition metrics, and rankings.
Days containing foods with missing fiber propagate to the weekly summary without converting missing fiber to zero. Status is PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE.
